questions.q: Do you live in a house or a flat?
questions.answer: I live in a flat, on the third floor of a building in a quiet residential area. It's a three-bedroom place I share with my family. It suits us well, though I do [[occasionally]] wish we had a bit more open space around us.

questions.q: How long have you lived there?
questions.answer: Well over a decade now, since I was a teenager. Before that we rented a smaller place nearby, so moving there felt like a real step up, and the flat is full of [[fond memories]] for all of us.

questions.q: Which room do you spend the most time in?
questions.answer: Definitely my bedroom, which doubles as my study, so I'm in there for most of the day when I'm home. I've arranged it to be quiet and comfortable, which makes it easy to [[concentrate]].

questions.q: Is there anything you'd like to change about your home?
questions.answer: I'd love a bigger balcony, to be honest. Ours is quite narrow, so there isn't much room for plants or a chair. A bit more outdoor space would make it far more [[inviting]] on pleasant evenings.

questions.q: What kind of home would you like to live in in the future?
questions.answer: Ideally, a small house with a garden, somewhere peaceful but still within reach of the town. I'd like to grow a few vegetables and have space for bookshelves. Nothing grand, just somewhere that feels like a genuine [[sanctuary]].
